name: Deafness
overview: Scripture presents deafness both as a physical condition and a powerful metaphor for spiritual insensitivity. God sovereignly controls human faculties, including hearing and speech, as seen in His declaration of creating the deaf and dumb (Exodus 4:11), and He commands respect and compassion toward the deaf (Leviticus 19:14). Prophetic passages illustrate how deafness can signify a hardened heart and moral insensibility, where people hear but do not understand or repent (Isaiah 6:10; Ezekiel 12:2). Yet, the Bible also promises miraculous restoration, envisioning a future when the deaf will hear and be spiritually healed (Isaiah 29:18; 35:5), underscoring God's power to open ears both physically and spiritually.
